name: Maya Lindqvist
quote: We launched with five directory listings ready on day one. The plan told me which five and linked each submission page. Two of them sent our first signups that week.

name: Dev Raghunathan
quote: I asked ChatGPT about our category before and after the fixes. We were missing the first time and named the second. I cannot prove the fixes caused it, but the gaps were real: no sitemap, no structured data, one listing.

name: Sofia Marchetti
quote: The competitor table showed two rivals listed on a dozen directories. We were on one. That picture was the whole launch plan.

name: Tomasz Wrobel
quote: Our robots.txt blocked a folder by mistake and we had no sitemap. We found both before launch day instead of after. The log made it easy to trust.
